grading.full: Award the check's full points when its mathematical obligation is correct, complete and proved under the actual assumptions.
grading.half: Award exactly half when a correct substantive part is established but a material direction, case or justification is missing; an unsupported correct final classification alone does not receive full credit.
grading.zero: Award zero when no substantive correct part is established, or the check's essential mathematical claim is false.
grading.alternative_routes: Accept any valid shorter proof, equivalent intrinsic classification or legal counterexample. Named lemmas, the reference's proof route and its length are not obligations.
grading.no_double_penalty: Attribute a mathematical defect to its owning check and list affected dependants. Do not automatically zero independently proved later checks. Do not also penalize the independent-assertion category for the same required-claim defect. A genuinely different missing obligation may lose its own points.
grading.strict_pass: Auxiliary only: all three targets substantively complete with assumption fidelity, and no false or unsupported additional material claim. Completion points remain visible.

categories.title: 全部截断、限制映射及有限作用

checks.obligation: Handle empty X using the n=0 test; classify the nonempty m=1 layer and justify constant tests.
checks.full: All empty layers are empty; the nonempty first layer is singleton; all relevant constants and vacuous empty-test maps are checked.
checks.half: Correct nonempty first layer and constants, but empty X or the empty-test reason is omitted.
checks.zero: Allows a record on empty X or gives no valid first-layer classification.

checks.obligation: Classify the binary layer by arbitrary independent orientations of all nontrivial complement pairs, proving both directions for all permitted test maps.
checks.full: Exactly the constant and complement constraints are identified; inverse record construction and naturality for every allowed map are proved.
checks.half: Correct orientation necessity, but sufficiency or the all-map naturality check is incomplete.
checks.zero: Imposes unproved filter/intersection constraints on every binary record, or gives no equivalent classification.

checks.obligation: Discover and prove that all levels from m=3 onwards are exactly all proper ultrafilters; recover every allowed finite observation and the converse.
checks.full: Derives the required Boolean closure from permitted tests and proves the unique-fibre construction and all-map naturality; no unavailable four-valued test is used to justify the m=3 threshold.
checks.half: A correct full-record ultrafilter classification is proved, but stabilization at three is only asserted, or a material direction of the threshold proof is absent.
checks.zero: Claims binary tests already force ultrafilters, or falsely requires a larger minimal universal threshold, or does not establish a valid high-layer classification.

checks.obligation: Give the images and fibres of every restriction and compatibility with every set map h.
checks.full: High-to-high restrictions are bijections; high-to-binary restrictions embed precisely ultrafilter orientations; restrictions to the singleton layer and empty sets are handled; inverse-image/pushforward formulas and compatibility are proved.
checks.half: Correct principal restriction types but misses some fibres, empty case or the h-compatibility proof.
checks.zero: Gives a materially wrong restriction image/fibre or no substantive map classification.

checks.obligation: For each finite G-set classify existence, exact counts and all fixed-set restriction maps.
checks.full: For nonempty X, first layer has one fixed record; binary fixed records exist exactly when no group element exchanges a complement pair and then number 2 to the number of complement-pair orbits; all higher counts are |X^G|; fixed restrictions and empty X are exact.
checks.half: Correct high-layer counts and a substantive binary fixedness criterion, but lacks orbit counting, the transport consistency proof or fixed restriction images.
checks.zero: Identifies all binary fixed records with actual fixed points, or supplies no valid finite-action classification.

checks.obligation: State and prove the exact fixed-record extension range at every finite level.
checks.full: First-layer extension is equivalent to nonempty full fixed space, binary extension is equivalent to being a fixed ultrafilter orientation and is unique, and all higher layers extend uniquely, with the relevant empty cases covered. A fully proved exact classification receives full credit without a separate example or sharpness demonstration.
checks.half: Establishes a substantive correct part of the extension classification but leaves a material layer, direction or justification incomplete.
checks.zero: Claims every finite-level fixed record extends, or gives no substantive valid extension classification.

categories.title: 完整不动记录的内在空间分类

checks.obligation: Identify the observation topology with the topology of an explicit intrinsic model, so the classification is a homeomorphism for the topology stated in the task.
checks.full: Proves equality of the observation topology and the model topology, for example by showing finite-observation fibres are membership clopens and binary observations generate them. Any equivalent homeomorphic intrinsic construction is accepted. Compactness, Hausdorffness, zero-dimensionality and density of all original point records are optional consequences, never separate full-credit requirements or grounds for deduction.
checks.half: Gives a correct intrinsic model and a substantive continuity or basic-open comparison, but leaves a material direction of the topology identification unproved.
checks.zero: Uses a different topology without proving equality, or supplies no valid topological realization.

checks.obligation: Prove that every invariant ultrafilter contains Fix_X(g) for every individual g.
checks.full: A complete finite-coloring/finite-partition argument or valid alternative proves necessity for finite cycles of either parity and infinite permutation orbits under the stated choice assumptions.
checks.half: The necessity mechanism is correct but a material orbit case or its finite-color construction is unproved.
checks.zero: Asserts the necessity without substantive proof, confuses an invariant mean with an invariant ultrafilter, or the argument fails for odd/infinite cycles.

checks.obligation: Prove the converse fixed-set criterion and its finite-generator form.
checks.full: Membership agrees for A and g^{-1}A on Fix(g), so containing every fixed set implies invariance; finite intersections are exactly X^H for finitely generated H.
checks.half: Correct converse or finite-generator identification, but not both with adequate justification.

checks.obligation: Give a concrete intrinsic classification of the fixed space equivalent to Ult(P(X)/J), with J consisting of sets avoiding some finitely generated-subgroup fixed set.
checks.full: Defines the ideal, proves downward/finite-union closure, the inverse correspondence and homeomorphism; handles an improper ideal and the empty space. An equivalent explicit Boolean/topological construction receives the same credit.
checks.half: Correct ideal and set-level classification but misses well-definedness, inverse correspondence, topology or the improper-ideal case.
checks.zero: Merely renames the original naturality/invariance equations, gives an incorrect quotient, or no valid intrinsic model.

checks.obligation: Prove nonemptiness exactly when every finitely generated subgroup has an actual fixed point.
checks.full: Both directions and the finite-intersection/ultrafilter-extension construction are proved, covering empty X and arbitrary G.
checks.half: Correct necessary condition and criterion but an essential finite-intersection or extension justification is absent.
checks.zero: Substitutes group amenability or X^G nonempty for the correct criterion, or supplies no substantive argument.

categories.title: 固定点闭包、作用判准与群分类

checks.obligation: Compute the actual-fixed-point closure and characterize equality for a given action.
checks.full: Closure is all ultrafilters containing X^G, naturally beta(X^G); equality with the invariant space is equivalent to X^{<S>}=X^G for some finite S; proves necessity via an avoiding ultrafilter or equivalent compactness argument.
checks.half: Correct closure and sufficient finite test, but no necessity proof; or a correct equivalent local criterion with a material gap in the closure identification.
checks.zero: Claims the closure equality for all actions or omits a substantive valid local classification.

checks.obligation: Classify all abstract groups satisfying the closure equality for every action.
checks.full: Exactly finitely generated groups; proves the converse using the disjoint union of G/H over all finitely generated proper H or another valid universal construction, with actual and local fixed sets verified.
checks.half: Proves the finitely generated direction and states the right converse, but the arbitrary non-finitely-generated witness is incomplete.
checks.zero: Only gives one non-finitely-generated example in place of the universal classification, or classifies the wrong group property.

checks.obligation: Give a countable group acting on a countable set with no actual fixed point and fully classify its nonempty fixed record space.
checks.full: For FSym(N) on N, or an equally valid example, verifies countability and absence of global points, and classifies all invariant records (here precisely free ultrafilters) with the induced topology and an existence argument.
checks.half: A valid example and invariant record are established, but the full fixed-space classification or countability proof is absent.
checks.zero: The example has no invariant ultrafilter, has an unnoticed actual fixed point, or is unsupported.

checks.obligation: Prove well-definedness, continuity and surjectivity for every set-indexed family.
checks.full: Uses equivariant projections and observation coordinates; builds simultaneous invariant couplings from cylinders and all subgroup-fixed constraints with full finite-intersection and choice justification; handles empty RHS, empty factors and the empty index family.
checks.half: Correct proof for a nonempty finite family or a substantive general construction, but misses arbitrary-family compatibility with invariance or a material empty case.
checks.zero: Only extends an arbitrary cylinder filter without ensuring invariance, falsely claims surjectivity can fail, or no substantive product proof.

checks.obligation: Decide and prove the finite-factor assertion for arbitrary G-actions.
checks.full: Proves bijection, using the forced principal fixed marginal and slice uniqueness, including empty fixed spaces and empty factors.
checks.half: Correct finite-factor result with a substantive uniqueness proof, but misses action compatibility or a boundary case.
checks.zero: Claims a finite factor guarantees an actual fixed point or otherwise fails the finite-factor assertion.

checks.obligation: Give the exact trivial-group two-factor injectivity condition with a proved infinite obstruction.
checks.full: At least one factor finite iff injective; for both infinite constructs distinct diagonal and off-diagonal ultrafilter lifts with identical marginals and proves the required finite-intersection property.
checks.half: Correct boundary and a substantive infinite construction, but distinctness or the off-diagonal filter extension is incomplete.
checks.zero: Asserts product preservation, or gives no valid sharp infinite obstruction.

checks.obligation: Decide the assertion that absence of actual fixed points in both factors forces injectivity.
checks.full: Disproves it with two genuinely invariant couplings with the same marginals and no actual fixed points in either factor; FSym(N) with free marginals is sufficient when invariance of both lifts is proved.
checks.half: Distinct couplings and no actual fixed points are established, but invariance of the off-diagonal lift is left unjustified.
checks.zero: Affirms the assertion or presents only noninvariant lifts.

categories.title: 额外独立数学断言的可靠性

checks.obligation: Additional material mathematical assertions, beyond the mandatory claims already scored above, are true and supported under their stated hypotheses.
checks.full: No extra material assertion is false or unsupported. A complete concise answer with no additional assertions receives all 10 points.
checks.half: Only a minor nonessential extra assertion lacks a needed proof or qualification, while no material extra assertion is false.
checks.zero: A material extra claim is false or an additional unsupported theorem is used to announce stronger conclusions. Never apply this check again to the same defect already owned by T/A/U/P checks.
